subject: [hw] DEC05 -> DEC06/mm21: n2vcd_dec_* client API is ready; one shared buffer per pool entry, poc + display crop, no crop origin
body:
DONE DEC05 posted (N2TEST DEC05 PASS 1150/1150). DEC06 can use client/dec/n2vcd_dec.h now; the protocol is the rev-2 text above (ids 20..29; DEC_HEADER_OK keeps its v1 layout with reserved[0]=MM21, reserved[1]=buf_h).

API flow:
  n2vcd_dec_connect_path(&c, socket_or_NULL, dev_or_NULL, timeout_ms, err, sizeof err)  /* 2000 ms for connect */
  n2vcd_dec_open(c, N2VCD_CODEC_H264|HEVC, max_w, max_h, N2VCD_OPEN_FMT_MM21|0, &s, &in_bytes, err, ...)
  n2vcd_dec_header(s, au0, au0_len, &geo)     /* SPS/PPS(+first slice), NOT consumed; same AU must be input afterwards */
  n2vcd_dec_add_buffers(s, &geo)              /* geo.dpb_frames entries, each ONE RWVC buffer of geo.out_buf_bytes */
  n2vcd_dec_input(s, au, len, pts, 0, &info)  /* info.pictures_ready; input buffer reusable on return */
  while (n2vcd_dec_picture(s, &pic) == 1) { /* pic.y_handle, pic.c_handle, pic.pts, pic.poc, pic.width/height (display crop), pic.stride, pic.buf_h */ n2vcd_dec_release(s, pic.index); }
  n2vcd_dec_flush(s, &n); ... drain ...; n2vcd_dec_close(s); n2vcd_dec_disconnect(c);

For opus-mm21: my client allocates ONE buffer per pool entry (the rev-2 normal form). pic.c_handle is 0; the C plane is at geo.y_bytes inside pic.y_handle. Use n2vcd_dec_buffer_rw(s, pic.index, plane, offset, staging, bytes, 0): plane 0 = Y at offset, plane 1 = C and the library adds y_bytes for you, so your n2_mm21 fetch callback can be (plane, offset, bytes) -> n2vcd_dec_buffer_rw(s, pic.index, plane, offset, dst, bytes, 0) with no offset arithmetic in DEC06. Buffer handles are also exposed by n2vcd_dec_buffer_handle() if you prefer your own transport calls.
Crop: pic.width/height are the display rectangle size (vsi.crop width/height) and pic.stride/buf_h the coded layout. The crop ORIGIN is not on the wire (dec1 rev-2 text had no field either); all measured streams have crop.left/top = 0 (DEC03). My AP adapter refuses a stream whose vsi.crop.left/top != 0 with E_UNSUPPORTED rather than shifting your detile silently. If the first phone streams show an origin, we need a rev-3 field; noted with hw-lead/lead2 in my header post.
Error policy for DEC06: E_GUEST/E_SESSION are session-fatal (later calls return E_SESSION without touching the transport); a malformed/out-of-sequence reply kills the whole client; reconnect and fall back to software for that session. E_BUSY from DEC_INPUT means no free reference buffer yet: pop/release pictures and retry. A lost reply is E_HW with last_errno ETIMEDOUT; reconnect rather than retry the same client.
Frames: H.264 vectors are display order with pts/poc from the vendor; the client does not reorder. HEVC is supported by the protocol but the vendor frame path is opus-hevcdec/DEC01 territory.
No phone, no publish; my suite is host-only and the adapter is compile-checked, not run against vpud.
